headline: Glynsera Build
title: Glynsera Build | Ice Strikes and Frost Tail Strike | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Glynsera is an Ice damage dealer with attack as its top stat. Ice Strikes quickly piles Ice Debuff stacks onto the target. Then Frost Tail Strike spends those stacks for a big extra hit. Its Biting Wind trait adds critical chance against targets with more than five stacks. Ice Tornado is the ultimate. Raise attack first, then regen, and bring Geoclaw as a partner. Is Glynsera on your team? Comment below!
description: Aniimo Glynsera build: Ice Strikes builds Ice Debuff, Frost Tail Strike spends it, Biting Wind adds crit above five stacks, Ice Tornado ultimate. Attack then Regen, partner Geoclaw.
joke: Its build is cool, and I am not even trying to be funny.
